emails.subject: Welcome to the Team, Champ!!
emails.body:
Hey there!!

Just wanted to be the first to officially welcome you to the cyber division! We are SO excited to have you on board. Big things happening around here, big things!!

Your job is pretty simple — just keep an eye on the inbox, filter out anything suspicious, and keep our systems clean. Easy stuff for a go-getter like you!

My door is always open. Well, not literally, I keep it closed for the AC. But you know what I mean!!

Let's make some magic happen, champ!!

Bob
Director, Cyber Division

emails.subject: Onboarding Documents
emails.body:
Hello and welcome!

We are so glad to have you joining us. Please find your onboarding checklist available on the HR portal at hr.fbi.gov. You will need to complete it within your first two weeks.

If you have any questions about benefits, payroll setup, or office policies, do not hesitate to reach out. We are here to help you settle in.

Wishing you a wonderful first day!

Amelia
HR Department, FBI

emails.subject: Workstation Setup
emails.body:
Hello,

Your workstation has been configured and is ready to use. Your network credentials were sent separately via the secure onboarding portal.

If you experience any issues with access or equipment, log a ticket at it.fbi.gov or call extension 5500.

Do not share your credentials with anyone, including IT staff. We will never ask for your password.

Alex
IT Department, FBI

emails.subject: Direct Deposit Setup
emails.body:
Hi there,

Welcome aboard! I just wanted to make sure your direct deposit information gets set up before the next pay period.

Please log in to the payroll portal at portal.fbi.gov and fill in your banking details at your earliest convenience. If you run into any issues, feel free to reach out directly.

Looking forward to making sure you get paid on time — that part is kind of important!

Trevor Woodyard
Payroll Department, FBI

emails.subject: Great Work Out There Champ!!
emails.body:
Hey!!

Heard you've been crushing it already — that's what I like to see!! The kind of energy that makes this division tick!!

Keep your eyes peeled, we have been seeing a slight uptick in phishing attempts lately. Nothing crazy, probably just some script kiddies trying their luck. You'll spot them a mile away, I'm sure!!

Remember — when in doubt, deny it out!! That's a Bob-ism, you can have that one for free!!

Keep up the great work!!

Bob
Director, Cyber Division

emails.subject: A Quick Check In
emails.body:
Hello,

I just wanted to check in and see how your first day is going! Starting a new job can be a lot to take in, especially here.

If anything feels overwhelming, please do not hesitate to reach out. That is what we are here for.

Also, gentle reminder — if you ever receive any emails asking for personal information or credentials, please report them to IT immediately. We have been seeing a few more of those lately than usual.

Take care of yourself!

Amelia
HR Department, FBI

emails.subject: Reminder: Report Suspicious Emails
emails.body:
Hello,

This is a friendly reminder that if you receive any emails requesting credentials, downloads, or urgent action, please do not interact with them.

Forward any suspicious emails to security@fbi.gov and delete them immediately. Our team will investigate.

When in doubt, the safest move is always to deny and report.

Alex
IT Department, FBI

emails.subject: URGENT: FBI Account Suspended!!!
emails.body:
YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN SUSPENDED DUE TO SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY!!!

Click the link below IMMEDIATELY to restore access before your files are permanently deleted!!!

This is your FINAL WARNING. You have 15 minutes to act.

http://fbi-secure-login.fb1.com/restore

Do not ignore this message!!!

emails.subject: Your Payment Has Been Declined
emails.body:
Dear FBI Employee,

We have detected a failed payment attempt on your account and have temporarily suspended your access as a security precaution.

To restore your account and avoid permanent closure, please verify your identity IMMEDIATELY by clicking the link below and entering your login credentials.

http://paypai-verify.com/fbi-login

This link expires in 30 minutes. Do not delay.

emails.subject: System Access Warning
emails.body:
ATTENTION FBI EMPLOYEE,

Our automated systems have flagged your account for unauthorised access from an unknown location.

You must confirm your credentials immediately to prevent your account from being locked out of all FBI systems permanently.

Click here NOW: http://fbi-alerts.com/verify-now

Failure to act within 1 hour will result in immediate account termination.
